tags.gist: Says regulated AI needs a common, verifiable way to show a model stayed within bounds, bearing on risk scoring and evaluation.
Proposes validating the version-locked constraints and deterministic verification around the model, with a human signature as an enforced interlock, rather than the model.
Supports the two axes and suggests applicants show that a function cannot structurally climb higher on the independence axis.
Would credential the decider, the deterministic gate plus signing person, evaluating and version-locking the constrained configuration premarket.
Wants postmarket records independently verifiable offline by a third party: tamper-evident, reproducible, and checkable without the manufacturer.
Suggests a sealed, verifiable envelope travelling with the article at each handover, covering PCCP changes and jurisdiction rules through on-premise evaluation.
Recommends a common, verifiable way to attest that constrained AI stayed within bounds, built on existing transparency standards such as SCITT and COSE receipts.
